chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad, from Sahl or someone else, from Muhammad ibn al-Walid, from Yunus, from Dawud ibn Zurbi, from Abu Ayyub al-Nahwi, who said:

Abu Ja'far al-Mansur sent for me in the middle of the night, so I came to him and entered upon him while he was sitting on a chair, with a candle before him and a letter in his hand. He said: when I greeted him, he threw the letter to me while he was weeping, and said to me: This is the letter of Muhammad ibn Sulayman informing us that Ja'far ibn Muhammad عليه السلام has passed away.
So surely we belong to Allah, and surely to Him we are returning.
He said it three times, and: where is the like of Ja'far عليه السلام?
Then he said to me: Write. He said: so I wrote the beginning of the letter. Then he said: Write: if he had appointed one specific man as his legatee, then bring him forward and strike his neck.
He said: then the reply returned to him that he had appointed five as legatees: one of them was Abu Ja'far al-Mansur, and Muhammad ibn Sulayman, and 'Abdullah, and Musa عليه السلام, and Hamidah.

key_terms.أَوْصَى: he appointed by will; referring to designation through bequest
key_terms.إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُ: the Qur'anic formula of return to Allah recited upon calamity
key_terms.جَوْفِ اللَّيْلِ: the depth of the night; indicating a summons at a late and sensitive hour
key_terms.خَمْسَةٍ: five; the number of persons named as legatees
key_terms.قَدْ مَاتَ: has passed away; announcing the death of Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad عليه السلام
key_terms.كِتَابُ: a written letter carrying official information
key_terms.مُوسَى: Musa عليه السلام; one of the named legatees in the report

ai.seo_question: How does this narration indicate the designation of Imam Musa al-Kazim عليه السلام after Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates the report of the death of Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad عليه السلام and the political reaction of Abu Ja'far al-Mansur. It also records the instruction concerning the Imam's designated legatee and the reply that five persons were named, including Musa عليه السلام. The narration is significant in the historical indication toward the Imamate of Abu al-Hasan Musa عليه السلام and the circumstances surrounding succession.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Muhammad, from Sahl, or someone else, from Muhammad Bin Al Waleed, from Yunus, from Dawood Zurby, from Abu Ayoub Al Nahwa who said,

‘Abu Ja’far Al-Manour (the Caliph) sent for me in the middle of the night. So I went over to him and came up to him, and he was seated upon a chair, and in front of him was a candle and in his hand was a letter. So when I greeted upon him, he threw the letter towards me and he was crying, and he said to me, ‘This is the letter of Muhammad Bin Suleyman informing us that Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> Bin Muhammad<sup>asws</sup> has passed away,
for we are for Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and to Him<sup>azwj</sup> are we returning
(three times), and where is the likes of Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>?’

Then he said to me, ‘Write!’ So I wrote the commencement of the letter. Then he said, ‘If it was so that he<sup>asws</sup> had bequeathed to one man in particular, so bring him forward and strike off his neck’.
So the answer returned to him that he<sup>asws</sup> had bequeathed to five – Abu Ja’far Al-Mansour, and Muhammad Bin Suleyman, and Abdullah, and Musa<sup>asws</sup>, and Hameyda’.
en.sarwar: 13. Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated from Sahl or an other person, from Muhammad ibn al-Walid from Yunus from Dawud ibn Zurbi from abu Ayyub al-Nahwi who has said the following.

“Abu Ja‘far, al-Mansur summoned me in the middle of the night and I went to see him. When met him he was sitting in a chair. Before him there was a candle and a letter in his hand. The narrator has said that I greeted him and he threw the letter to me while was weeping. He said, “This is a letter of Muhammad ibn Sulayman in which he has informed us that abu Ja‘far ibn Muhammad (a.s.) has died.
We are for Allah and to Him we will all return.
He said it three times. Where is anyone like Ja‘far? “

Then he said to me, “Write down.” The narrator has said that I then wrote. I wrote the introduction of the letter. He (Mansur) said, “Write to ask if he has left a directive will to any man particularly, if so summon him and kill him.”

He has said that reply to hisletter came back that said the Imam (a.s.) has in fact, left a will to five people and one of them is abu Ja‘far al-Mansur, Muhammad ibn Sulayman, ‘Abdallah, Musa and Hamida.”
